lines.text: In 1961, a Yale psychologist asked ordinary people to give electric shocks to a stranger. Up to 450 volts.
lines.say11: [serious] In 1961, a Yale psychologist asked ordinary people to give electric shocks to a stranger. [pause] Up to four hundred and fifty volts.

lines.text: Two out of three went all the way.
lines.say11: [low, grave] Two out of three... went all the way.

lines.text: The conclusion became famous. Under orders, almost anyone will hurt someone.
But the shocks were fake. The victim was an actor. And that's where it gets complicated.
lines.say11: [beat] But the shocks were fake. The victim was an actor. [pause] And that's where it gets complicated.

lines.text: Decades later, a researcher listened to the original tapes.
Many participants said they had doubts the shocks were even real.
lines.say11: [curious] Many participants said they had doubts the shocks were even real.

lines.text: And the man giving orders often went off script, pushing much harder than the official rules.
Then there are the versions you never hear about. When the orders came by phone, obedience dropped to about one in five.
When two scientists disagreed, nobody went to the end.
lines.say11: When two scientists disagreed... [pause] nobody went to the end.

lines.text: And when a later study used the harshest order, you have no other choice, people stopped.
lines.say11: And when a later study used the harshest order... [dramatic] "you have no other choice"... [beat] people stopped.

lines.text: So the lesson isn't that we blindly obey. People kept going when they believed in the cause. When they were simply commanded, they refused.
lines.say11: [thoughtful] So the lesson isn't that we blindly obey. People kept going when they believed in the cause. When they were simply commanded... they refused.

lines.text: So the real question isn't, would I obey? It's, what do I believe in enough to go too far?
lines.say11: [warm, intimate] So the real question isn't... would I obey? [pause] It's... what do I believe in enough to go too far?

lines.text: Next file: a test that was supposed to predict your whole future, with one marshmallow.
lines.say11: [mysterious] Next file: a test that was supposed to predict your whole future... [whispers] with one marshmallow.
